goal: Verify that a user can create a new account, navigate the calendar to the next month, and select a specific date to filter memos for that day.
instructions: On the 'Create your account' page, enter 'alice' into the 'Username' field and 'SecureP@ss123!' into the 'Password' field, then click the 'Sign up' button.
Once logged in and viewing the calendar (initially showing June 2026), click the 'Next month' arrow button to navigate to July 2026.
In the July 2026 calendar view, click on the date '15' to select July 15.
success_criteria: The user is successfully logged in and the main dashboard with the calendar is visible.
The calendar header displays 'July 2026' after navigating from the previous month.
The date '15' in the July 2026 calendar is visually highlighted or selected.
The memo input area displays a timestamp or filter tag indicating '2026-07-15'.
The main content area displays 'No data found' or shows memos specifically associated with July 15, 2026.
